### 3.2 Docker Configuration

```dockerfile
# docker/Dockerfile.ros2
FROM osrf/ros:humble-desktop-full

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV ROS_DOMAIN_ID=42

# System dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    python3-pip \
    python3-colcon-common-extensions \
    ros-humble-moveit \
    ros-humble-ur-robot-driver \
    ros-humble-ur-description \
    ros-humble-nav2-bringup \
    ros-humble-slam-toolbox \
    ros-humble-robot-localization \
    ros-humble-realsense2-camera \
    ros-humble-image-pipeline \
    ros-humble-pcl-ros \
    ros-humble-gazebo-ros-pkgs \
    ros-humble-ros2-control \
    ros-humble-ros2-controllers \
    ros-humble-gripper-controllers \
    libopencv-dev \
    librealsense2-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Python dependencies
COPY requirements.txt /tmp/
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir -r /tmp/requirements.txt

# Create workspace
RUN mkdir -p /agribot_ws/src
WORKDIR /agribot_ws

COPY . /agribot_ws/src/agribot_pro/

RUN /bin/bash -c "source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && \
    colcon build --symlink-install"

RUN echo "source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash" >> ~/.bashrc
RUN echo "source /agribot_ws/install/setup.bash" >> ~/.bashrc

ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/bash", "-c", "source /agribot_ws/install/setup.bash && exec $0 $@"]
CMD ["ros2", "launch", "agribot_pro", "full_system.launch.py"]
```

```yaml
# docker/docker-compose.yml
version: '3.8'

services:
  agribot_core:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile.ros2
    container_name: agribot_core
    privileged: true
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - ROS_DOMAIN_ID=42
      - DISPLAY=${DISPLAY}
      - NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all
      - NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all
    volumes:
      - /tmp/.X11-unix:/tmp/.X11-unix:rw
      - ../config:/agribot_ws/src/agribot_pro/config:ro
      - ../ml_models:/agribot_ws/src/agribot_pro/ml_models:rw
      - agribot_data:/data
    devices:
      - /dev/video0:/dev/video0
      - /dev/ttyUSB0:/dev/ttyUSB0
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: 1
              capabilities: [gpu]
    command: ros2 launch agribot_pro full_system.launch.py

  agribot_ml:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile.ml
    container_name: agribot_ml
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all
    volumes:
      - ../ml_models:/app/ml_models:rw
      - agribot_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: 1
              capabilities: [gpu]

  agribot_dashboard:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile.dashboard
    container_name: agribot_dashboard
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
      - "8765:8765"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://agribot:agribot@db:5432/agribot_db
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
    depends_on:
      - db
      - redis

  db:
    image: postgis/postgis:15-3.3
    container_name: agribot_db
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: agribot_db
      POSTGRES_USER: agribot
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: agribot
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: agribot_redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"

  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    container_name: agribot_grafana
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana

volumes:
  agribot_data:
  pgdata:
  grafana_data:
```

### 3.3 Configuration Files

```yaml
# config/robot_params.yaml
agribot:
  robot_name: "agribot_pro_001"
  version: "2.0.0"
  
  ur5e:
    ip_address: "192.168.1.100"
    rtde_frequency: 500  # Hz
    control_frequency: 125  # Hz
    payload_kg: 5.0
    reach_mm: 850
    
    joint_limits:
      velocity: [3.14, 3.14, 3.14, 6.28, 6.28, 6.28]  # rad/s
      acceleration: [8.0, 8.0, 8.0, 12.0, 12.0, 12.0]  # rad/s^2
    
    tool_center_point:
      x: 0.0
      y: 0.0
      z: 0.185  # gripper offset
      rx: 0.0
      ry: 0.0
      rz: 0.0
    
    home_position: [-1.5708, -1.5708, 1.5708, -1.5708, -1.5708, 0.0]
    
    workspace_limits:
      x: [-0.85, 0.85]
      y: [-0.85, 0.85]
      z: [0.01, 1.2]

  mobile_base:
    type: "differential_drive"
    max_linear_velocity: 1.0  # m/s
    max_angular_velocity: 1.5  # rad/s
    wheel_separation: 0.54
    wheel_radius: 0.15
    
  sensors:
    rgb_camera:
      type: "realsense_d435i"
      resolution: [1280, 720]
      fps: 30
      fov: 87  # degrees
      
    depth_camera:
      type: "realsense_d435i"
      resolution: [1280, 720]
      fps: 30
      min_depth: 0.1
      max_depth: 10.0
      
    lidar:
      type: "velodyne_vlp16"
      channels: 16

### 3.2 Docker Configuration

```dockerfile
# docker/Dockerfile.ros2
FROM osrf/ros:humble-desktop-full

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV ROS_DOMAIN_ID=42

# System dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    python3-pip \
    python3-colcon-common-extensions \
    ros-humble-moveit \
    ros-humble-ur-robot-driver \
    ros-humble-ur-description \
    ros-humble-nav2-bringup \
    ros-humble-slam-toolbox \
    ros-humble-robot-localization \
    ros-humble-realsense2-camera \
    ros-humble-image-pipeline \
    ros-humble-pcl-ros \
    ros-humble-gazebo-ros-pkgs \
    ros-humble-ros2-control \
    ros-humble-ros2-controllers \
    ros-humble-gripper-controllers \
    libopencv-dev \
    librealsense2-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Python dependencies
COPY requirements.txt /tmp/
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir -r /tmp/requirements.txt

# Create workspace
RUN mkdir -p /agribot_ws/src
WORKDIR /agribot_ws

COPY . /agribot_ws/src/agribot_pro/

RUN /bin/bash -c "source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && \
    colcon build --symlink-install"

RUN echo "source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash" >> ~/.bashrc
RUN echo "source /agribot_ws/install/setup.bash" >> ~/.bashrc

ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/bash", "-c", "source /agribot_ws/install/setup.bash && exec $0 $@"]
CMD ["ros2", "launch", "agribot_pro", "full_system.launch.py"]
```

```yaml
# docker/docker-compose.yml
version: '3.8'

services:
  agribot_core:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile.ros2
    container_name: agribot_core
    privileged: true
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - ROS_DOMAIN_ID=42
      - DISPLAY=${DISPLAY}
      - NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all
      - NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all
    volumes:
      - /tmp/.X11-unix:/tmp/.X11-unix:rw
      - ../config:/agribot_ws/src/agribot_pro/config:ro
      - ../ml_models:/agribot_ws/src/agribot_pro/ml_models:rw
      - agribot_data:/data
    devices:
      - /dev/video0:/dev/video0
      - /dev/ttyUSB0:/dev/ttyUSB0
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: 1
              capabilities: [gpu]
    command: ros2 launch agribot_pro full_system.launch.py

  agribot_ml:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile.ml
    container_name: agribot_ml
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all
    volumes:
      - ../ml_models:/app/ml_models:rw
      - agribot_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: 1
              capabilities: [gpu]

  agribot_dashboard:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile.dashboard
    container_name: agribot_dashboard
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
      - "8765:8765"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://agribot:agribot@db:5432/agribot_db
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
    depends_on:
      - db
      - redis

  db:
    image: postgis/postgis:15-3.3
    container_name: agribot_db
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: agribot_db
      POSTGRES_USER: agribot
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: agribot
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: agribot_redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"

  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    container_name: agribot_grafana
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana

volumes:
  agribot_data:
  pgdata:
  grafana_data:
